cases.title: ABT - Card Presentation - Visa
cases.custom_preface: To verify that an open payment transaction is performed on the Platform Validator when a valid Visa Card is presented
cases.custom_preconds:
**Given** the Validator is 'In Service' 
**And** there are the following conditions:

* A valid Visa payment card is available
* The Validator is communicating with the CloudFare back office
* Access to CloudFare
* Access to the ABT Operator Portal

custom_steps_seperated.content: **When** the payment card is presented to the Validator
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**Then** the card is successfully read
**And** the Validator displays the "Tap Successful" screen

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**When** the User examines the 'Activity Log' under 'Estate Management' in CloudFare with the following filters:

* Activity - Transaction
* Device Type - Platform Validator
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**Then** a transaction record for the Tap is displayed
**And** the following information is shown

||| :Audit Type: | :Validator: | :Amount: | :Status: 
|| Transaction - OpenPayment |Platform Validator | £0:00 | Authorised

**And** a Tap ID is shown

custom_steps_seperated.content: **When** the Operator Portal -> Journey History is inspected for the payment card
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **Then** no record for the Tap is displayed

custom_steps_seperated.expected:

cases.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** a user has a new valid Child iLink Zone 1 smartcard (previously unused)
**AND** the platform validator is in service
**AND** the platform validator is on the Dublin Line

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the user presents the Child iLink Zone 1 smartcard to the platform validator card reader
**WHEN** the user removes the smartcard from the platform validator
**WHEN** the CloudFare activity logs are checked
**WHEN** reviewing the data in Smartrack
**WHEN** reviewing the data in Merit
**WHEN** reviewing the data in Merit Web Reporter

cases.custom_expected:
**THEN** the smartcard has been updated as per the validation
**AND** when the smartcard details are reviewed on other devices (ETM/TVM/POS/HHD) the latest state can be identified

cases.custom_preface:
As a Transport Operator I want the PV (NIR) to apply a countdown timer to the following smartcards when they validate, so that cards that are revalidated within the countdown timer count as transfers not journeys

**NOTE**
Can be validated on either PV, ETM or HHD.
cases.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** PV is commissioned
**AND** PV is communicating with BOS
**AND** an Adult Belfast Visitor smartcard validated within the configured Transfer Period
**AND** BOS access is available

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the card is presented to the PV within Transfer period and not while smartcard is in passback period

*Note time here for reference when reviewing audit data
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the device displays the following screens:

- Validation success with product name
- Sales screen
- Displays that Smartcard is in Transfer Period

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** on CloudFare select Estate Management screen
**AND** select Activity Log and filter on:

- Activity: Transaction
- Device Type: Platform Validator
- Date: Today's date
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the audit records displayed will include the transaction at the correct time-stamp

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** on Merit select Client Tools -> Browse Audit Data
**AND** select the following filters and apply:

- Duty Date - current date
- Driver - operator signed in

**AND** highlight the displayed operator and select Transaction Detail
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the audit records displayed will include the transaction at the correct time-stamp

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** on SmarTrack search on the ESN or PSN of the smartcard
**AND** highlight the card entry and press Display
**AND** in the tree view highlight the card token and select the Transactions tab
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the audit records displayed will include the transaction at the correct time-stamp

cases.custom_expected: Then the device is valid for Transfer

cases.title: TIBU-19395 - Change in adapter connectivity detection has caused issues with TL networks
cases.custom_preface:
Believed as part of the late data changes brought into the PV build from the ETM, a change in the way the Ethernet adapter connection is determined has resulted in Ethernet not working as a comms method within the Translink networks. 

The “new” way in which the Ethernet connectivity is performed is to use a socket.poll command to the gateway and any response back is considered positive confirmation that the adapter is connected, and then we move on to doing DNS lookups for endpoint monitoring.

Unfortunately this looks to be being defeated by the Translink corporate and BRT networks that are very locked down. We believe (assume) that previously we pinged the gateway to determine Ethernet adapter connectivity.

We need to look at reverting this approach (at least for Translink) so that the Ethernet adapter is seen as connected and to ensure it can be used for comms. This is admittedly disappointing because on our own (far less restricted) network the new approach works really well.

This change will need to be made as the “only” change on top of 3.0.7 to expedite testing and release to Translink. Most importantly is that the subsequent build must not include the reversion of the “trust all” certificate change as we will not be updating the PV OS prior to January.
cases.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** the PV is In Service
**AND** both working Ethernet and Sim are connected to PV
**AND** both cellular and FEC1 are showing as connected in network settings

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the user unplugs the Ethernet cable 
**AND** the user signs into Technician Menu
**AND** selects the Network Settings option
**WHEN** the user signs out of Technician
**WHEN** the user performs multiple smartcard taps on the PV
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the smartcards presented are validated 
**AND** the audit data for those transaction can be found in Cloudfare Activity Log

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the user plugs back in the Ethernet cable
**AND** the user signs into Technician Menu
**AND** selects the Network Settings option
**WHEN** the user signs out of Technician
**WHEN** the user performs multiple smartcard taps on the PV
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the smartcards presented are validated 
**AND** the audit data for those transaction can be found in Cloudfare Activity Log

cases.custom_expected: Ethernet connection is primary method of connection, when Ethernet connection is lost it will failover to cellular. When Ethernet connection is regained then it will return back to Ethernet connection.

cases.title: TIBU-24428: TL PV "PrimaryCommsChannelFailed" event spamming seen in CF on build 3.1.1 in TL Test Environment
cases.custom_preface:
Description

We have an apparent issue with the 3.1.1 PV build reported by Translink when testing in their test environment, where it is frequently “spamming” CF with the “PrimaryCommsChannelFailed” event, suggesting that the PV is frequently flipping between ethernet and cellular. 

We do not see the same issues in our own Poole test environment, so this may be a pointer that the issue is a Translink network problem.

TL have reported that they do not see the spamming if the cellular SIM is removed from the PV, and the PV will continue to communicate over ethernet with no “PrimaryCommsChannelFailed” event spamming. At face value this is odd, but it may simply be another indication of a poor network, and the lack of any “PrimaryCommsChannelFailed” event spamming in this scenario may be simply because we have no secondary comms channel to fail over to with the SIM removed.

DEBUG logs have been attached along with a screenshot of the event spamming to better direct investigation.

Some possible points of interest within the logs:

Failed to send an audit record, and then 5 seconds later failed over to cellular (GFTS.log1.txt):

2025-07-07 14:02:00.771 WARN [BackOfficeAgent] - BOSRecordHandler batch send ended - send failure \SD Memory\GFTS\BOSRecords\000000\00000060.evt
2025-07-07 14:02:05.710 INFO [NetworkConfiguration] - [Network Route] Monitor Route: Adaptor FEC1, Route backofficeprimary, available False

Modem IP Comparison Oddity:

2025-07-07 14:02:07.595 DEBUG [NetworkConfiguration] - ConnectionState: OS IP 10.100.211.23 and Modem IP 100.103.117.238 do not match
2025-07-07 14:02:07.596 DEBUG [NetworkConfiguration] - ConnectionState: OS IP 100.103.117.238 and Modem IP 100.103.117.238 match

The above maybe normal, it is logged often. It looks like it is first comparing the IP address of the ethernet with the Modem IP and finding they don’t match (as expected) but on the very next line after it does correctly match the Modem IP so this is probably nothing to be concerned about?

Exception:

2025-07-07 14:02:05.694 WARN [NetworkConfiguration] - [NetworkRouteDestinationClient] SendWebRequest WebException: Error while processing request./jikdl.atufc: Error while processing request. ---> System.Net.Sockets.SocketException: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond


The above exception seems to be what is consistently aligning with when we raise the PrimaryCommsChannelFailed “set” event and fail over to cellular.

NOTE: The screenshot added of CF is showing “pairs” of the PrimaryCommsChannelFailed” event which is not immediatley obvious from the screenshot. the PrimaryCommsChannelFailed event is a set/clear event.

Environment


TL test environment (t2-env2) with PV 3.1.1 build

Closure Reason


None
Requirements


GIVEN I have a reliable ethernet connection
WHEN The PV is powered on
THEN The PV should continue to communicate over ethernet
AND Not fail over to cellular
cases.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** The PV is in Service
**AND** The PV has an ethernet connection

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** The Cloudfare/Activity Logs are inspected for the PV
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the PV continues to communicate over ethernet
**AND** Does not fail over to cellular

cases.title: TIBU-25444 - TL PV : Issue with barcode expiry date shown on PV when validating barcode (NIR)
cases.custom_preface:
Similar to the issue found on the GV with the introduction of the changes for CR116 (TIBU-25154) there appears to be an issue with the way the PV is displaying the expiry date of the barcode when it is validated. 

Please see attached images. 

”Barcode Ticket” shows the original purchase time of the barcode (11:39) and the barcode purchased has a validation time of 3.5 hours based on the topology used. This should mean that the barcode expires at 15:09 however the expiry time on the screen shows 14:09 as per the “Validation Screen” image.

cases.title: Technician - Technician adjusts the audio volume settings
cases.custom_preface: The purpose of this test is to ensure a Translink engineer can manually adjust the volume settings
cases.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** an engineer has logged into the 'Technician Menu'
**AND** the 'Audio Volume' has been selected
**AND** the platform validator is on a Glider route

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the volume is not at its maximum
**AND** the engineer selects the right arrow
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indicator moves one place to the right
**AND** the volume gets incrementally louder

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the engineer selects the right arrow again
**AND** continues to select the right arrow until the indicator is full
**AND** continues to select the right arrow when the volume is already at its maximum
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indicator moves incrementally to the right
**AND** the volume is at its maximum
**AND** the volume remains at the same level

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the engineer selects the left arrow
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indicator moves one place to the left
**AND** the volume gets incrementally quieter

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the engineer selects the left arrow again
**AND** continues to select the left arrow until the indicator is at its lowest
**AND** continues to select the left arrow when the volume is already at its minimum
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indicator moves incrementally to the left
**AND** the volume is at its minimum
**AND** the volume remains at the same level

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the engineer presses an area on the right hand side of the volume indication bar
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indication bar fills up to the point of the finger press
**AND** the volume gets louder ( *this should be equivalent to the number of spaces it has gone up* )

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the engineer presses an area on the left hand side of the volume indication bar
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the volume indication bar empties to the point of the finger press
**AND** the volume gets quieter ( *this should be equivalent to the number of spaces it has gone down* )

cases.custom_expected: **THEN** the volume settings can manually be adjusted

cases.title: TIBU-22248 - Device requires two deployments to enable barcode reading
cases.custom_preface:
PV 3.1.0

Barcode Reader isn't correctly reading barcodes, tried two different barcode readers. One of the reader was getting a partial read, which sporadically get the validator to display Not valid at this location screen. In the other reader got zero response on the validator when a barcode was presented,

The work around for this is to deploy a dataset down to the devices which has barcodes disables. Once the devices have updated to that dataset, we then send down another dataset which has barcodes reenabled. Once that dataset is deployed the barcode readers are then working as expected.
